model names are checked against the catalogue when saved.

ones serve nothing, so a role using one moves on to its next fall-back.

delete.description: Remove the saved setting so the environment default applies again.

post.description: Send one tiny request with the primary model of these settings (costs a few tokens).

schema.title: Response Invite User Admin Users Post
Response Set Communities Admin Users  Sub  Communities Put
Response Disable User Admin Users  Sub  Disable Post
Response Set Role Admin Users  Sub  Role Put

get.description: Infrastructure readiness only. `/query` stays closed until the agents are implemented.
Search by words when `q` is given, otherwise browse the newest recordings.
Members see their own recordings, reviewers those of their communities, admins every one.

schema.title: Response List Recordings V1 Recordings Get

post.description: Withdraw one recording at once: no further processing, indexing or playback.

put.description: Admin only. Public needs the community's public-sharing consent; the change is audited.
